en.sayed-ali-raza: From the slave of Allāh, ‘Alī, Amīr al-mu’minīn

to the people who became wrathful for the sake of Allāh when He was disobeyed on His earth and His rights were ignored and oppression had spread its coverings over the virtuous as well as the vicious, on the local as well as the foreigner. Consequently, no good was acted upon nor any evil was avoided.
